prompt: Create README.md for a command-line tool named tidy-csv. It removes duplicate rows from CSV files and normalizes header names to snake_case. Cover install with pip, basic usage, the options --dedupe-key, --keep first|last and --dry-run, and one worked example.

In chat, without creating any files: explain how HTTP caching works with ETag and Cache-Control headers, for a backend developer who has never configured caching. Cover how a browser revalidates and when to choose max-age over no-cache.

In chat, without creating any files: draft an email to my engineering team. Our weekly sync moves from Monday 09:00 to Thursday 14:00 from 1 December. I want objections by Friday, and the old calendar invite gets cancelled.

Create retry.py: a Python module with a retry decorator. It supports exponential backoff with jitter, a maximum number of attempts, and a tuple of exception types to retry on. Include docstrings and comments, and a short usage example in the module docstring.
Create docs/rotate-api-key.md: a short how-to for rotating an API key with zero downtime, in a service that reads the key from an environment variable and runs as two replicas behind a load balancer.
